detail.title: Mechanisms of Memory Continuity vs. Identity
detail.summary: This notebook explores the hypothesis that episodic memory provides temporal continuity in autonomous agents, but persistent identity requires an integrative, potentially self-ethnographic layer that reconciles memory with internal regulatory invariants.
detail.reason: Synthesis of memory and identity mechanisms is required to move the project from active to evaluated status.

detail.title: Governance as the Mechanical Foundation of WAKE
detail.summary: Governance modules provide rigid invariants for WAKE, but autonomous agent behavior remains conditioned by environmental interface specifications, such as the Gymnasium Ant environment, which delineate the system's operational limitations.
detail.reason: Incorporating Open Ant environment evidence provides the necessary breadth to evaluate governance limits.
